name: Adani Lushlands
summary: The project exists. Its developer (Adani Realty), its location (Sector 2, Gwal Pahari), its RERA number (RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/837/569/2024/64, dated 14.06.2024), its 12.36-acre land area, its 4 towers and its under-construction status are confirmed. Our starting price of ₹9.97 Cr is far below the developer's ₹14.04 Cr onwards. Possession sources split between March 2029 (developer and Square Yards) and June 2029 (RERA-style date on some portals). Unit counts disagree (236 ours vs 251/208), and our 'GF' sizes match the developer's 6 BHK duplex penthouses rather than ground-floor units.
